{{Top|leg}}
'''Tatooine blues''' was a genre of [[Music/Legends|music]] formed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to express the sad desolation of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

[[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] band [["Smooth" Banjaxx Wab and the Scundereds]] played "dirty" Tatooine blues with some virtuoso [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] flourishes.<ref name="TLAOTH">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>
